input_output_contract: Full GPU-resident displacement, velocity and scalar physical wave speed to both full GPU-resident fields at all 49 observations. Include projection, every cold-fit start, parameter preparation, evolution and dense output; exclude host transfers, compilation and mesh-only assembly.
selection: Select the fastest median parity-passing geometry variant, requiring all u/v/energy trajectory parity <1e-8, baseline-equivalent finite/rank decisions, stationary initial fits, normal backward error <1e-10. Timestep arms are distinct method settings: all-state physical error may not worsen by >0.2 percentage point relative to baseline; time self-refinement <=1%. Phase and energy balance reported separately.
claim_scope: Two opened reflective development cases, frozen k32/r64 checkpoint. Geometry algebra and timestep screening are separate. No final cohort opened and no broad generalization claim.
